Liverpool vs Leeds United: Live Stream & Watch Online

As Liverpool prepares to face Leeds United at Anfield, fans can expect an exciting showdown between two teams with distinct ambitions in the England - Premier League. Both clubs are keen to secure vital points as the season reaches its halfway mark, with Liverpool pushing for a top-four finish while Leeds fights to remain safe from relegation. The match promises high stakes and thrilling football on January 1, 2026. Kick-off: 01.01.2026, 17:30 UTC / 20:30 MSK
Stadium: Anfield
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Liverpool currently finds itself in contention for a Champions League spot, showcasing a potent attacking lineup bolstered by the likes of Mohamed Salah and Darwin Núñez. After a rocky start to the season, Jürgen Klopp has managed to stabilize his side, and the team's chemistry is evident on the pitch. They will seek to extend their unbeaten run against a Leeds side that has shown vulnerabilities in defense but possesses a resilient spirit. On the other hand, Leeds United, under the management of a new head coach following a challenging start to their season, is desperate for points to avoid the relegation battle. Their recent form has been inconsistent, but they have demonstrated moments of flair that could prove significant against a formidable opponent like Liverpool. The clash at Anfield not only poses an opportunity for Leeds to upset the hosts but also to build momentum and confidence for the upcoming fixtures.

Team Form and Analysis

Liverpool

Liverpool's defense has inevitably seen some challenges this season, with injuries plaguing key players. However, the return of Virgil van Dijk has bolstered their backline, while the ever-reliable Alisson Becker remains a crucial last line of defense. Offensively, the Reds are near unstoppable, with their front three capable of tearing through any defense. Expect Klopp to deploy a high-pressing game, aiming to exploit any lapses in Leeds' defensive setup.

Leeds United

Leeds has faced significant scrutiny regarding their defensive fragility, often leaving gaps that can be easily exploited by sharper opponents. However, the introduction of new tactical strategies under the current management is showing promise. With a frontline led by Rodrigo and Jack Harrison, Leeds will likely aim to counter-attack swiftly while hoping for an inspired performance from their key players. Their success hinges on striking a balance between solid defense and effective attacking moves.

Crystal Palace vs Fulham: Live Stream & Watch Online

The upcoming clash between Crystal Palace and Fulham promises to be an exciting encounter as both teams look to secure vital points in the competitive landscape of the English Premier League. With the new year approaching, both clubs are keen to make a strong statement, not only for their league standings but also for the fans. Crystal Palace, known for their resilient home performances, face a Fulham side that has been finding their rhythm recently. This match could have key implications for both teams as they navigate the busy January schedule.

Kick-off: 01.01.2026, 17:30 UTC / 20:30 MSK
Stadium: Selhurst Park
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Crystal Palace comes into this match after a series of mixed performances in recent weeks. Under the management of Roy Hodgson, the Eagles have shown flashes of brilliance, particularly in their defensive organization. However, inconsistency has plagued their ability to convert opportunities into victories. On the other hand, Fulham, managed by Marco Silva, has demonstrated resilience and attacking flair, making them a dangerous opponent. Their recent form shows a steadiness that they will hope to capitalize on during their visit to Selhurst Park.

In the Premier League context, every point is crucial, especially with the relegation battle heating up. Crystal Palace will need to leverage their home advantage, while Fulham aims to carry forward their momentum after recent positive results, including some impressive draws against top-tier teams. As both teams eye a strong start to the calendar year, expect a heated and competitive match-up.

Team Form and Analysis

Crystal Palace

Defensively, Crystal Palace has been solid, with a well-structured backline that has successfully nullified threats from oppositional forwards in recent games. However, their attack has struggled, with a disappointing return in goals from their key forwards. The return of top striker Wilfried Zaha could provide the spark they need to rejuvenate their offensive play. As far as injuries go, the squad is relatively fit apart from a few minor doubts that could influence the starting lineup.

Fulham

Fulham has exhibited a more attacking approach this season, emphasizing ball retention and pressing high up the pitch. Stars like Aleksandar Mitrović have been pivotal in terms of both scoring and creating chances. They come into this match buoyed by their ability to score, having found the net consistently in recent fixtures. There are concerns regarding squad depth, with a couple of players sidelined for this match. Understanding Fulham's tactical intent to dominate the midfield will be crucial for Crystal Palace's defensive strategy.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • Crystal Palace: 4-3-3
    • Goalkeeper: Vicente Guaita
    • Defenders: Joel Ward, Marc Guéhi, Joachim Andersen, Tyrick Mitchell
    • Midfielders: Conor Gallagher, Luka Milivojević, Eberechi Eze
    • Forwards: Wilfried Zaha, Odsonne Édouard, Jordan Ayew
  • Fulham: 4-2-3-1
    • Goalkeeper: Bernd Leno
    • Defenders: Kenny Tete, Tosin Adarabioyo, Issa Diop, Antonee Robinson
    • Midfielders: Harrison Reed, João Palhinha
    • Forwards: Bobby De Cordova-Reid, Andreas Pereira, Aleksandar Mitrović

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: Draw - Both teams are evenly matched and may cancel each other out.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals - Given the defensive strengths and attacking frailties of both sides, a low-scoring affair seems likely.

Sunderland vs Manchester City: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the new year begins, Sunderland welcomes the formidable Manchester City to the Stadium of Light for a Premier League showdown that promises to be both exciting and crucial for both teams. Sunderland, fighting to pull away from the relegation zone, will face a City side that's competing for the top of the league table. With contrasting ambitions and recent forms, this opening fixture of 2026 sets the stage for a captivating encounter. Kick-off: 01.01.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Stadium of Light
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Sunderland is currently in a precarious position, struggling to consistently pick up points after a string of disappointing results. The Black Cats will look to their home advantage to turn their fortunes around. Manager Tony Mowbray has been under pressure to deliver, but the team has shown glimpses of potential with some exciting young talent, albeit plagued by inconsistency. In contrast, Manchester City appears unstoppable at this juncture of the season, sitting high in the table under the astute management of Pep Guardiola. Having an impressive squad packed with quality and depth, City has been in formidable form, scoring freely and showcasing a solid defense that has enabled them to maintain pressure on league leaders. Sunderland will need to be at their best to challenge the Cityzens in this battle.

Team Form and Analysis

Sunderland

Sunderland has struggled defensively this season, often leaving gaps that top teams like Manchester City can exploit. Their forward line has shown promise, with players like Ross Stewart capable of scoring, but service has been inconsistent. Injury concerns linger, with several players on the treatment table, which has challenged Mowbray's squad rotation and selection options. However, a few key players, including the ever-reliable Alese in defense, could return and provide a much-needed boost.

Manchester City

Manchester City has exhibited remarkable form, with their attack spearheaded by the likes of Erling Haaland, who has been a revelation since joining the club. City's defense, marshaled by Ruben Dias, has been resolute, conceding very few goals. As with every match, Guardiola has the tactical arsenal to adjust formations, and they will likely maintain a high-pressing game against Sunderland. However, they remain vulnerable to set-pieces, a potential opening that Sunderland may need to exploit.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Sunderland (4-2-3-1):
  • Goalkeeper: Anthony Patterson
  • Defenders: Lynden Gooch, Daniel Batty, Alese, Patrick Roberts
  • Midfielders: Luke O’Nien, Corry Evans
  • Forwards: Jack Clarke, Alex Pritchard, Ross Stewart
Manchester City (4-3-3):
  • Goalkeeper: Ederson
  • Defenders: Joao Cancelo, Ruben Dias, Aymeric Laporte, Kyle Walker
  • Midfielders: Rodri, Kevin De Bruyne, Bernardo Silva
  • Forwards: Riyad Mahrez, Erling Haaland, Jack Grealish

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: Manchester City to Win
    • The class and depth of City's squad should see them through against a struggling Sunderland side lacking confidence.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals
    • Given City's attacking prowess and Sunderland’s defensive vulnerabilities, this match could easily see multiple goals scored. Tune in for what promises to be a thrilling start to the new year of football!

Brentford vs Tottenham Hotspur: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Premier League clash between Brentford and Tottenham Hotspur on January 1, 2026, promises to be an exhilarating encounter as both teams are eager to start the new year on a high note. With Brentford looking to secure vital points at home, and Tottenham aiming to consolidate their place in the top tier of the table, this derby is set to provide an entertaining spectacle for fans. Both teams exhibit contrasting forms coming into this match, adding extra intrigue to this exciting fixture.

Kick-off: 01.01.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Brentford Community Stadium
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Brentford has had a mixed run leading into this fixture, showcasing resilience but struggling against top teams. The bees have proven to be a tough nut to crack at home, emphasizing their defensive strength, but their attacking unit needs to step up to secure goals against high-caliber opponents like Tottenham. Under the guidance of their ambitious manager, Brentford aims to translate home advantage into precious points.

On the other hand, Tottenham Hotspur arrives with a reputation for dazzling attacking football, currently vying for European qualification. Their recent performances have ignited hope among fans, especially with a series of dynamic displays from their key players. Spurs will look to capitalize on Brentford’s vulnerabilities while maintaining their defensive solidity as they navigate this crucial start to the year.

Team Form and Analysis

Brentford

Brentford has established itself as a formidable defensive team, often relying on their organized backline led by their experienced centre-backs. However, recent matches have revealed gaps that potent attackers can exploit. In terms of injuries, Brentford will miss a couple of key players due to fitness issues, which may affect their attacking arsenal. Nonetheless, players like Ivan Toney and Bryan Mbeumo are crucial and need to be at their best to create chances and score goals.

Tottenham Hotspur

Tottenham boasts a strong attacking front that has proven capable of unlocking even the most stubborn defenses. With Harry Kane and Heung-min Son at the helm, they are known for their quick counter-attacks and clinical finishing. The squad depth is robust, with several attacking options on the bench ready to make an impact. However, Spurs must address some defensive frailties, especially against high-pressing teams like Brentford. Despite a few minor injury concerns, manager Ange Postecoglou is expected to field a strong team.

  • Brentford: Raya; Ajer, Pinnock, Jansson; Henry, Norgaard, Jensen, Roerslev; Mbeumo, Toney, Wissa
  • Tottenham Hotspur: Lloris; Emerson, Romero, Dier, Udogie; Hojbjerg, Bissouma; Kulusevski, Kane, Son

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

  • Main Prediction: Tottenham Hotspur to Win - Given their attacking prowess and recent form, Spurs should secure a victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals - Both teams have shown the capability to score, indicating a high-scoring affair could be on the cards.
